name: Vascari (freight-crate style: "Lord V—")
origin: Outlaw Vampire Sommeliers — From Outer Space! (camp short); The Lodger Arc 1 (romantic interlude, same world)
veo_lock: A pale man who appears in his late twenties, ink-black hair worn slightly too long, pale grey eyes, sharp high cheekbones and fox-like features, a listening-animal stillness. Charcoal wool frock coat of an old-fashioned cut, black waistcoat, high white collar, dark cravat, black leather gloves on both hands. Immaculate, unhurried, courteous.
voice_descriptor_veo: a young man's low, unhurried voice with a soft North Carolina drawl, courteous in an old-fashioned way

voice.provenance: 3 harvest rounds 2026-08-22. R1 ('faintly accented' descriptor) drifted European aristocrat - A/B rejected+deleted. R2 (soft NC drawl steer) -> C, beaten by pure-S8 clone S ('S is better'), deleted. R3 (hard steer: 'warm NC drawl, soft country vowels, gentle Southern cadence' + southern-idiom lines w/ contractions) -> tightest cluster (X mutual 0.81-0.86; X1 0.783/X4 0.763/X6 0.736 vs S8), all word-perfect -> S2. Live A/B: S vs S2. See voice/provenance.md.

history.name: A narrow
history.note: S8+V1 (round-1 harvest). Rejected: European-aristocrat drift. Deleted.

history.name: B wide
history.note: S8+V1/V2/V3/V5 (round-1). Rejected: same drift, further diluted. Deleted.

history.name: C southern (round 2)
history.note: S8+W1/W5/W6. Stephen picked S over it ('S is better... lean into the southern a touch harder'). Deleted.

history.name: S pure (S8-only seed)
history.note: Beat round-2 C but Stephen wanted more southern lean; lost the final A/B to S2. Deleted (recreatable from samples/01_s8_good_evening.wav).

notes: Always gloved in company until Lodger Ep 7. Never in sunlight; silent when he moves (no footstep foley ever). Pays in old gold. In the wider myth he is a sommelier and is eventually killed by Deputy Holloway — never winked at on screen in Arc 1.
